modules.module_title: Introduction and Mount the Components on the PCB

pcs.pc_description: Describe the role and responsibilities of a Sr. Operator – Through Hole Assembly; explain the scope of through-hole technology in electronics manufacturing and the use of axial/radial insertion machines, digital assembly instructions, and related tools for efficient PCB assembly.
Identify the daily PCB-loading list and Check the components received from the preparation section and insert them correctly as per the instructions.
Ensure the leads are properly fitted before further processing.
Check the placement of inserted components to ensure they are straight.
Bend the component leads extending through the holes and apply adhesive to secure them to the PCB.
Firmly mount the components using hand tools as per the circuit diagram.
Hand over the assembled boards to the wave solder machine operator.
Solder the components onto the circuit boards at the soldering station.
Assemble PCB components using axial and radial insertion machines to ensure efficient and accurate through-hole component placement.

modules.module_title: Set Up and Operate the Machine

pcs.pc_description: Set up tools and required parts to operate the machine.
Place insertion chutes in the programmed locations for efficiency.
Ensure polarity marking and loading direction as per the job sheet.
Control the insertion sequence and lead formation to match hole dimensions.
Load PCB fixtures and move them to the correct location for assembly.
Set the machine to zero settings before starting the operation
Ensure the anvil cutter properly trims and bends the leads for secure placement
Use screen-based or digital assembly instructions to enhance accuracy and minimize dependence on printed manuals during assembly operations.
Follow ESD and contamination prevention standards while assembling all PCBs.
Monitor machine operation to ensure compliance with quality standards.
Visually inspect assembled PCBs for missing or incorrectly placed components.

modules.module_title: Undertake Preventive Maintenance of the Machine

pcs.pc_description: Maintain the machine to prevent unscheduled downtime.
Perform regular cleaning, weekly greasing, and nozzle maintenance.
Repair minor machine faults or call a service technician if required.
Inspect belts, gears, and moving components for wear and replace them as needed.
Check and tighten electrical connections to prevent malfunction
Document maintenance activities and update service records regularly.
Monitor machine performance trends to predict potential failures
Ensure all safety interlocks and emergency stops are functional.
